subject: ELECTRICAL PUMPS AND VALVES OPERATION SKILL

practicals.title: Experiment - 1
content: To study, working and operating practice of reciprocating pumps,
single acting piston pump, double acting simplex pump

practicals.title: Experiment - 2
content: To study and measurement of various electrical quantities by using
electrical measuring instruments.

practicals.title: Experiment - 3
content: To study construction, working and operation of electrical motor
used for reciprocating pumps, single acting piston pump, double
acting simplex pump.

practicals.title: Experiment - 4
content: Working and operating practice of diaphragm pump and centrifugal
pump.

practicals.title: Experiment - 5
content: Working, construction and operation of electrical motor used for
diaphragm pump and centrifugal pump

practicals.title: Experiment - 6
content: Working and operating practice of isolation valve, regulating valve,
back flow prevention valve and pressure relief valve

practicals.title: Experiment - 7
content: Working, construction and operation of electrical motor and control
system used for isolation valve, regulating valve, back flow
prevention valve and pressure relief valve.

practicals.title: Experiment - 8
content: Working and operating practice of gate valve and globe valve

practicals.title: Experiment - 9
content: Working, construction and operation of electrical motor and control
system used for gate valve and globe valve

practicals.title: Experiment - 10
content: Working and operating practice of ball valve and diaphragm valve.

practicals.title: Experiment - 11
content: Working, construction and operation of electrical motor and control
system used for ball valve and diaphragm valve.

practicals.title: Experiment - 12
content: Working and operating practice of venturi meter

practicals.title: Experiment - 13
content: Working and operating practice of orifice Meter

practicals.title: Experiment - 14
content: Working and operating practice of rotameter

practicals.title: Experiment - 15
content: Working and operating practice of pitot-tube.

practicals.title: Experiment - 16
content: Working, construction and operation of electrical transducer used
for flow measurement devices

practicals.title: Experiment - 17
content: Working and operating practice of U-tube manometer

practicals.title: Experiment - 18
content: Working and operating practice of inclined tube manometer

practicals.title: Experiment - 19
content: Working and operating practice of pressure gauges.

practicals.title: Experiment - 20
content: Working and operating practice of thermowell

practicals.title: Experiment - 21
content: Working and operating practice of thermister

practicals.title: Experiment - 22
content: Working and operating practice of temperature pyrometer

practicals.title: Experiment - 23
content: Working, construction and operation of electrical transducer used
for pressure and temperature measurement devices
Total Hours 56
